title.fa: نقش اجتماعی و شهری بازار و افول آن در دوران معاصر
title.en: The bazaar's social and civic role and its modern decline
title.nl: De sociale en stedelijke rol van de bazaar en zijn achteruitgang

summary.fa: بازار در شهر ایرانی فقط محل خرید و فروش نبود: راه اصلی شهر بود و مسجد جامع، مدرسه، کاروانسرا و خدمات عمومی کنارش جا داشتند. شهرسازی نوین این پیوند را سست کرد.
summary.en: The bazaar was more than commerce: it was the main artery of the city, with the congregational mosque, schools, caravanserais and public services beside it. Modern urban change loosened that bond.
summary.nl: De bazaar was meer dan handel: hij was de hoofdader van de stad met moskee, scholen en karavansarais ernaast. Moderne stadsontwikkeling verzwakte die band.

text.fa: بازار معمولاً در امتداد مهم‌ترین گذرگاه شهر شکل می‌گرفت و تقریباً همهٔ فضاها و فعالیت‌های همگانی به آن وصل بود.
text.en: The bazaar usually followed the city's most important thoroughfare, and nearly all public spaces and activities connected to it.
text.nl: The bazaar usually followed the city's most important thoroughfare, and nearly all public spaces and activities connected to it.

text.fa: مسجد جامع، مدرسه‌های علمیه و بناهایی چون ضرب‌خانه، زورخانه و حمام کنار بازار یا نزدیک آن ساخته می‌شدند.
text.en: The congregational mosque, madrasas, and buildings such as the mint, zurkhaneh and bathhouse were built beside or near it.
text.nl: The congregational mosque, madrasas, and buildings such as the mint, zurkhaneh and bathhouse were built beside or near it.

text.fa: چون خبر بیشتر شفاهی دست‌به‌دست می‌شد، بازار کانون پخش خبر و اطلاعات هم بود.
text.en: Since news travelled largely by word of mouth, the bazaar was also a hub for news and information.
text.nl: Since news travelled largely by word of mouth, the bazaar was also a hub for news and information.

text.fa: در دوران معاصر خیابان‌های سواره، دگرگونی شیوهٔ تولید و عرضه و مراکز خرید پراکنده، بازار را به کانون صرفاً اقتصادی فروکاسته‌اند.
text.en: The author argues that car streets, changed production and retail, and scattered new shopping centres have reduced the bazaar to a mainly economic role.
text.nl: The author argues that car streets, changed production and retail, and scattered new shopping centres have reduced the bazaar to a mainly economic role.

text.fa: بازارهای کهن را می‌توان سه گروه کرد: بازار شهرهای بزرگ که زنده مانده اما دستکاری شده؛ بازار شهرهای میانه با کاربرد محدود؛ و بازار شهرهای کوچک که تقریباً متروک شده است (مانند نائین و زواره).
text.en: Historic bazaars fall into three groups: large-city bazaars still alive but altered, mid-sized-city bazaars with limited use, and small-town bazaars largely abandoned (Nain and Zavareh are cited).
text.nl: Historic bazaars fall into three groups: large-city bazaars still alive but altered, mid-sized-city bazaars with limited use, and small-town bazaars largely abandoned (Nain and Zavareh are cited).

text.fa: جایگاه بازار در سیاست و اقتصاد ایران (مثلاً در دورهٔ مشروطه و انقلاب) موضوع پژوهش‌های دیگری است که این بخش از کتاب نمی‌پردازد.
text.en: The bazaar's political and economic role (for instance in the Constitutional and 1979 revolutions) is covered by other scholarship, not by the sections read here.
text.nl: The bazaar's political and economic role (for instance in the Constitutional and 1979 revolutions) is covered by other scholarship, not by the sections read here.
